items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-keitora-white
reasons: 4: body drawn in oblique/isometric projection — cab nose points SE, bed recedes diagonally up-left (rows 7-46), cab shows both a south face and a receding east side plane with the windscreen as a diagonal (cols ~62-110, rows 9-34); wheels sit on a diagonal baseline (rear row 37, front row 46). SAME-CHIPSET anchors jp-truck-kei / jp-car-white are axis-aligned side profiles with a flat top band.

8c: no drawn outline or line work — the silhouette is a ragged stair-stepped blob of soft white/grey clusters (rows 8-30), like a downscaled painted render, not the crisp 1-px line drawing of jp-truck-kei (dark tinted outline, ruled panel lines).
Map 01/04: the truck sits askew to the road grid next to axis-aligned anchor vehicles; reads as a tumbled toy.
fixes: Redraw as an axis-aligned east- or west-facing side profile on the jp-truck-kei template (64x48): roof top band 3-4 rows, bed opening seen from above showing cargo (the green/brown crates + blue tarp) as a 5-7 row inner plane, flat south face, two wheels on one baseline row.
Add the chipset's dark tinted outline and ruled panel lines; drop the soft blob shading.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-red-tractor
reasons: 1/3: engine hood (cols 33-60, rows 28-48) is a flat side-elevation slab: its top is only rows 28-29 (1-2 rows of light rim) above vertical louvre stripes; no foreshortened hood plane, where anchor jp-truck-kei shows a 3-4 row roof band and the bed interior from above.

3: sunshade canopy (cols 12-34, rows 12-29) is a flat vertical striped rectangle outlined on all sides with the stripes running straight down — no slope/top edge toward the viewer and no roof plane; it reads as a hanging banner, not a canopy seen from above.
3: rear rotary tiller (cols 1-12, rows 24-47) is a vertical yellow/orange face with no top surface; seat/steering not visible from above at all (rows 28-46 is an undifferentiated grey engine block).
fixes: Give the hood a 3-4 row top plane (lighter red, with the exhaust stack cap as an ellipse) ending in a front-edge line, then the louvred side below.
Draw the canopy roof as a 4-5 row striped plane seen from above, with 1 row eave shadow and thin posts down to the seat; show the seat top (3-4 rows) and steering wheel as an ellipse.
Give the tiller cover a 2-3 row top band.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-single-car-train
reasons: Roof drawn as a deep plane seen from above (rows 0-18) with AC units/vents and pantograph-free diesel roof gear, ending in a front-edge line at row 18; side body rows 19-38, bogies 39-47 — same construction as SAME-CHIPSET anchor jp-train-car-a.
Crisp 1-px grid, tinted outlines; reads clearly as a Kiha railcar at 1x in map 03 alongside the anchor commuter car.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-bicycle-parked
reasons: 4: the two wheels are drawn as overlapping discs offset diagonally (rear wheel cols 3-17 rows 7-26, front wheel cols 18-30 rows 10-31) — the bike recedes on a diagonal, an oblique/isometric pose rather than an axis-aligned side profile.

8d: at 1x the frame, saddle and handlebar are lost in a grey-blue jumble (rows 9-24); it reads as a pair of grey blobs, not a bicycle. No seat top or basket top can be identified, so the view cannot be confirmed (sure=false).
fixes: Redraw as an axis-aligned side-profile bicycle like the bikes in anchor jp-bike-shelter: two wheels on one baseline, clear 1-px dark frame triangle, saddle as a 2-row top, handlebar line, optional front basket showing its inside from above (3-4 rows).
Use a dark tinted outline so wheels and frame separate at 1x.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-wooden-pole-transformer
reasons: 6: the pole's top end (rows 0-2) is just two white insulator nubs and a sliver of brown over the crossarm — no elliptical cap; anchor jp-pole-wood ends in a 10-row dome/cap and a crossarm with a 5-row top plane.
3: the transformer can (cols 3-12, rows 12-27) is a closed cylinder drawn as a flat grey front face with rounded corners only — no lighter elliptical lid seen from above.
Crossarm (rows 3-10) is noisy brown/white speckle with a 3-row dark front band; its top is barely distinguishable from the insulators.
fixes: Cap the pole with an elliptical cap plate (≥4 rows, wider than the shaft) above the crossarm, as in jp-pole-wood.
Give the transformer a 3-4 row light ellipse lid with a darker rim line, then the grey cylinder side shaded left-to-right.
Clean the crossarm into a clear top plane (3 rows light) + front edge (2 rows dark), insulators sitting on top.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-roadside-mirror
reasons: Same construction as SAME-CHIPSET anchor jp-mirror2: orange hood/top over the round mirror (rows 1-6), mirror face rows 6-11, pole rows 12-26, base plate with a 2-row top (rows 27-28) and front rows 29-30.
Crisp grid, tinted orange/brown outline, legible at 1x.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-well-handpump
reasons: 2: the well opening (cols 3-20, rows 11-17) shows at most 2-3 rows of dark/blue interior, partly covered by a brown lid jumble; the minimum 4 rows of opening interior seen from above is not met and the far rim is not readable.

8d: at 1x the well curb (rows 11-28) is a muddy brown-grey mass with no stone courses or rim line; only the green pump reads. The pump head (cols 21-31, rows 6-24) is a vertical green slab with no cap.
Map 01: next to the jizo/mirror pieces the well reads as a pile of rubble with a green stick.
fixes: Draw the well curb as a round/square stone ring: far rim, 4-6 rows of dark water interior with a highlight, near rim and 6-8 rows of stone-course front face, dark tinted outline.
Pump: give the head a 2-3 row elliptical cap, a clear spout and handle; stone/concrete basin with a 3-row top seen from above.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-rice-rack-hasagi
reasons: kind: a hasagi rice-drying rack is an open rack (frame), not a building/gate structure; it holds goods (sheaves) so front_prop does not fit.

1 (as frame): the horizontal beam carrying the sheaves has no top face anywhere — rows 0-3 are only the crossed X-pole tips, rows 3-27 are a flat front wall of straw; the dark band rows 20-22 is a front-facing strip. Context jp-rg-hazakake at least shows a 3-row beam top (rows 4-7); the sheaves here are not drawn heaped as seen from above (no back edge behind them).
Reads as a yellow fuzz wall at 1x in maps 03/04; the sheaf/beam structure is hard to separate.
fixes: Draw the top rail as a 3-row pole seen from above (light top, dark front edge) with the sheaves draped over it so their tops/back halves show above the rail (2-3 rows), then hang down in front.
Make the X-legs read as poles with 1-px dark outline and give the base a 1-2 row ground shadow; separate individual sheaves with darker tinted gaps.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-scarecrow-pair
reasons: kind: scarecrows are figures (closest_kind figure); the mound bases (rows 26-30) show a ~3 row lighter top, so charge 2 does not strictly hold, but the straw hats (rows 3-11) are formless domes with no brim ellipse, so the from-above read is uncertain (sure=false).

8c: no line work — bodies (rows 11-26) are soft clusters of blue/red/brown with no outline or readable arms, face or post; painterly downscaled texture, unlike the crisp outlined SAME-CHIPSET jp-jizo (dark tinted outline, clean shapes) and even context jp-rg-kakashi.
At 1x in maps 02/03/04 the pair reads as two hatted blobs; next to the single context kakashi they look blurred.
fixes: Redraw each scarecrow on the jp-rg-kakashi construction: straw hat as an ellipse brim (4-5 rows seen from above) with crown, cloth head, crossbar arms as a clear horizontal line with sleeves, kimono body, post down to a mound with a 3-row top.
Add a dark tinted outline per part and limit each material to 3-4 tones.

summary: Group C: 2 pass (single-car-train, roadside-mirror), 7 fail. Keitora and bicycle are drawn on an oblique/isometric diagonal (charge 4) and look like downscaled renders; tractor hood/canopy/tiller have no tops (1/3); pole-transformer lacks a pole cap and transformer lid (6/3); well opening too shallow and illegible (2/8d); hasagi is really a frame with no beam top (1); scarecrow pair is a figure but drawn as soft blobs without line work (8c).
